how_to_apply: Download the advertisement and the prescribed application form from the official DPCC website: dpcc.delhigovt.nic.in
Fill the application form in the prescribed proforma, in English or Hindi.
Attach a recent passport-size photograph and all required self-attested documents.

Route the application through proper channel, along with bio-data, attested APAR dossier copies for the last 5 years, Integrity Certificate, Vigilance Clearance, and statement of Major/Minor penalties (if any).
Superscribe the name of the post applied for on the envelope.
Send the completed application to: The Administrative Officer, Delhi Pollution Control Committee, 3rd Floor, IT Park, DMRC Building, Shastri Park, Delhi-110053.
Ensure the application reaches DPCC within the relevant phase deadline (31 July 2026 / 14 August 2026 / 31 August 2026).

content_sections.text: The maximum age limit for deputation is 56 years as on the last date of receipt of applications. The crucial date for determining age limit is the closing date for receipt of applications from candidates in India.

content_sections.heading: DPCC Recruitment 2026 Selection Process
content_sections.text: The official notification does not specify a detailed, separate selection process document. However, it refers to candidates needing to submit a No Objection Certificate (NOC) from their department for appearing in an interview, which indicates that shortlisted candidates will be called for an interview as part of the selection process. Beyond this, further selection criteria are not available in the official notification.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required for DPCC Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Duly filled application form in the prescribed proforma, in English or Hindi Bio-data, duly signed by the concerned officer Attested copies of APAR (Annual Performance Appraisal Report) dossier for the last 5 years Integrity Certificate Vigilance Clearance Statement of Major/Minor penalties, if any, imposed during the last ten years Self-attested copies of certificates of proof of age Self-attested copies of certificates of educational qualifications Self-attested copies of certificates of work experience Self-attested proof of belonging to SC/ST/OBC/Persons with Disability category, where applicable Recent passport-size photograph Applications that are incomplete, not routed through proper channel, or not accompanied by attested copies of the APAR dossier and other related documents will not be considered.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for DPCC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Since this is a Rolling Advertisement, applications are accepted in three phases: up to 31 July 2026 (Phase 1), up to 14 August 2026 (Phase 2), and up to 31 August 2026 (Phase 3).

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in DPCC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 54 tentative vacancies across 12 post categories, including Senior Environmental Engineer, Environmental Engineer, Assistant Environmental Engineer, Scientists, Legal Assistant, and System Analyst.

faq.question: Q3. Who is eligible to apply for DPCC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Officers and officials working on a regular basis in Central Government, State Government, Union Territory, Recognized Research Institutes, Autonomous Bodies, Statutory Bodies, or PSUs are eligible. Officers working in private organisations, or who are unemployed, retired, or on contractual basis, are not eligible.

faq.question: Q4. Is this a permanent recruitment or on deputation basis?
faq.answer: This recruitment is on deputation basis (including short term contract) for a period of one year, extendable up to three years.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for DPCC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for deputation is 56 years as on the last date of receipt of applications.

faq.question: Q6. How can I apply for DPCC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted offline, through proper channel, in the prescribed proforma downloaded from the DPCC website, and sent to the Administrative Officer, DPCC, 3rd Floor, IT Park, DMRC Building, Shastri Park, Delhi-110053.
